text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
دور 1 علمي / 2020 / Sep.

Q1) Reading Comprehension: ( 20 Marks )
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow.   (10 M.)

A certain old gentleman was very unhappy about modern education, and thought that young people nowadays were not being taught the importance of knowing the difference between right and wrong. One day he was taking a walk in the park near his home when he saw some young boys standing around a small cat. The old gentleman went up to the boys and asked them what was happening. One of the boys said to him, "We're having a game. We're telling lies, and the one who tells the biggest one gets to keep the cat." The old gentleman thought that this was a good opportunity to teach the boys a useful lesson, so he said to them. "I've never told a lie in my life." All at once there was a great shout from all the boys, and they said, "You've won! You can take the cat!"

كان رجل عجوز غير سعيد بشأن التعليم الحديث، واعتقد أن الشباب في الوقت الحاضر لا يتم تعليمهم أهمية معرفة الفرق بين الصواب والخطأ، ذات يوم كان يمشي في الحديقة بالقرب من منزله عندما رأى بعض الأولاد الصغار يقفون حول قطة صغيرة. ذهب الرجل العجوز إلى وسألهم عما يحدث، قال له أحد الأولاد، "اننا نلعب لعبة، والشخص الذي يقول أكبر كذبة يحصل على القط". في الحالة، كان هناك صراع عليه من جميع الأولاد، وقالوا، "لقد فزت! يمكنك أن تأخذ القط"

1. How did the old gentleman feel about modern education?
2. The boys let the old gentleman have the cat because .......... (a. he had told the biggest lie   b. he was older than they were)
3. What did the old gentleman think young people should be taught?
4. What did the old gentleman see in the park one day?
5. The old gentleman wanted more attention to be paid to morals. (a. True   b. False)
6. Give the passage a suitable title.

4. What was Zaid Tariq doing when he saw the shark?
5. Why shouldn't an interpreter waste time thinking?
6. People have to follow the law so that we can all live together safely. (a. True   b. False)

subject: إنكليزي
text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
دور 1 تطبيقي / 2020 / Sep.

Q1) Reading Comprehension: ( 20 Marks )
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow.   (10 M.)

Mr. Johnson was a rich old man. He lived in a beautiful house in the country with lots of servants, but his wife was dead, and he did not have any children. Then he died suddenly. and people said, "His servants killed him, because they wanted his money." But the servants said. "No, he killed himself." The police came and asked the servants a lot of questions, and after a few weeks, there was a big trial. There were two famous lawyers and several important witnesses. "Tell me," One of the lawyers said to a witness one day, "did Mr. Johnson often talk to himself when he was alone?" "I don't know," the witness answered at once. "You don't know?" the lawyer repeated angrily. "You don't know? But you were his best friend, weren't you? Why don't you know?" "Because I was never with him when he was alone," the witness answered.

كان السيد جونسون رجلاً غنياً، كان يعيش في منزل جميل في الريف به الكثير من الخدم، لكن زوجته ماتت ولم يكن لديه أولاد. ثم مات فجأة. وقال الناس، "قتلته خدمته لأنهم أرادوا ماله". لكن الخدم قالوا، "لا، فقد قتل نفسه". جاءت الشرطة وسألت الخدم أسئلة كثيرة، وبعد أسابيع قليلة كانت هناك محاكمة كبيرة. كان هناك محاميان مشهوران والعديد من الشهود المهمين. قال أحد المحامين لشاهد ذات يوم، "أخبرني"، "هل تحدث السيد جونسون غالباً مع نفسه عندما كان بمفرده؟" أجاب الشاهد: "لا أعرف". "أنت لا تعرف؟" كرر المحامي بغضب. "أنت لا تعرف؟ ولكنك كنت صديقه المفضل، ألم تكن كذلك؟ لماذا لا تعرف؟" أجاب الشاهد: "لأنني لم أكن معه قط عندما كان بمفرده."

1. Mr. Johnson was a rich old man. (a. True  b. False)
2. Where did Mr. Johnson live?
3. What did people say when Mr. Johnson died?
4. What did the police do?
5. The witness said, "Mr. Johnson often talked to himself." (a. True  b. False).
6. Give the passage a suitable title.

4. Why did Zaid Tariq scream?

6. Fingerprints and footprints can be used to... ..........

11. I bought him a new mobile phone last week and he already lost it. (Correct the sentence)

5. How (many / much) time do you spend on your homework?
6. Please put out your cigarette. You (mustn't / most) smoke in the police station.

subject: إنكليزي
text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
دور 2 تطبيقي وادبي / 2020 / November

Q1) Reading Comprehension: (20 Marks)
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow:   (10M.)

The computer is one of the most important inventions of the modern world. It has changed our lives in many ways. The first computers were very big and expensive. They filled a whole room and only a few people could use them. Today computers are much smaller and cheaper. Almost everyone can use a computer at home or at work. Computers help us to do many things quickly and easily. In medicine, computers are used to examine patients and to help doctors to find out what is wrong with them. Scientists use computers to do difficult calculations. Pilots use computers to know directions and to fly safely. Even children use computers to learn and to play. In short, the computer is one of the greatest inventions that has ever changed our life.

الحاسوب واحد من أهم الاختراعات في العالم الحديث. لقد غيّر حياتنا بطريقة كثيرة. كانت الحواسيب الأولى كبيرة جداً ومكلفة. كانت تملأ غرفة كاملة ويمكنetashek استخدام عدد قليل منها فقط. واليوم أصبحت الحواسيب أصغر بكثير وأرخص تقريباً. ويمكن لكل شخص استخدام حاسوب في بيته أو في عمله. تساعدنا الحواسيب علىLogger عمل أشياء كثيرة بسرعة وسهولة. في الطب، تستخدم الحواسيب لفحص المرضى ومساعدة الأطباء لمعرفة ما.recipe عندهم. يستخدم العلماء الحواسيب لإجراء الحسابات الصعبة. يستخدم الطيارون الحواسيب لمعرفة الاتجاهات والطيران بأمان. حتى الأطفال يستخدمون الحواسيب للتعلم والعب. باختصار، الحاسوب واحد من أعظم الاختراعات التي غيرت حياتنا.

1. How do computers help doctors?
2. How were computers in the past different from computers today?
3. How do computers help scientists?
4. Pilots use computers to know directions. (True / False)
5. Computers are developing all the time. (True / False)
6. Give the passage a suitable title.

B/ Answer or complete (5) of the following sentences using information from your text book: (10M.)
1. Why do some officers direct traffic?
2. Samira's active language is Arabic. (True / False)
3. Why was Mustafa's mother unconscious?
4. Holidays can give us a chance to ……… (a. learn new activities  b. stop thinking about our problems)
5. Tariq was rescued by two children. (True / False)
6. What is a radar detector?

Q2) Grammar and Functions: (30 Marks)
A/ Re-write the following sentences, follow the instructions between brackets. (Choose 10)  (20M.)

2. (Show me your passport). (Use the past of "could")
3. My father asked somebody to fix the computer. My father ……… (Re-write with the correct form of "have")
4. Define a cartoonist. (Use "draws amusing pictures")

6. I spoke to a lady on the phone. She told me to call back later. The lady ……… told me to call back later. (Combine using a relative pronoun to make one sentence)
7. Last year, my friend Zeina (get) hurt in a car accident. (Correct the form of the verb)
8. I bought him a new mobile phone last week and he already lost it. (Correct the sentence)
9. Can I borrow some money? She asked me ………. .
10. Unfortunately, I left my camera at Faten's house. That's why I couldn't get a picture of the dolphin. (Regret use: "If only")
11. She's in 6th preparatory. She's doing well at school. (Expectation use: "should")
12. Most smokers ( take up / it ) as teenager. (Put the verb and the object in the correct order)

B/ Choose the correct word between brackets: (5 only)  (10M.)

2. He's really (boring / bored) in his free time.
3. Would you mind (open / opening) the window?
4. I (have / used to have) a bike when I was a child.
5. He works (at / in) the biggest bank in Baghdad.
6. You've made (few / fewest) mistakes this year.

subject: إنكليزي
text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
تمهيدي علمي / 2020 / June

Q1) Reading Comprehension: (20 Marks)
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow. (10M.)

Food is one key to a comfortable life. We eat vegetables and fruit. We also eat animal products like milk, eggs and meat. Food is necessary for us to live, move and work. To be useful, it should be organized with correct amounts. Food can be in different groups. A group of food gives us power. A second group gives us vitamins. A third group builds our body. The way we feel may be the result of the kind of food we eat. We may feel happy when we eat chocolate. We may feel sleepy when we eat fat rich food. We may be upset when we eat the food we don't like. Food is essential, but we should choose the food that is healthy and belongs to different groups.

الغذاء هو أحد مفاتيح الحياة المريحة. نحن نأكل الخضار والفاكهة. نحن نأكل أيضاً المنتجات الحيوانية مثل الحليب والبيض واللحوم. الغذاء ضروري لنا للعيش والحركة والعمل. لكي يكون مفيداً، يجب تنظيمه بكميات صحيحة. يمكن أن يكون الطعام في مجموعات مختلفة. مجموعة واحدة تعطينا قوة. المجموعة الثانية تعطينا الفيتامينات. المجموعة الثالثة تبني أجسامنا. قد تكون الطريقة التي نشعر بها حسب نوع الطعام الذي نأكله. قد نشعر بالسعادة عندما نأكل الشوكولا. قد نشعر بالنعاس عندما نأكل الطعام الغني بالدهون. قد نكون منزعجين عندما نأكل الطعام الذي لا نحبـه. الغذاء ضروري، لكن يجب أن نختار الطعام الصحي الذي ينتمي إلى مجموعات مختلفة.

1. What do we eat?
2. Why is food necessary?
3. Food is one key to a comfortable life. (a. True  b. False)
4. Food can be in different groups. (a. True  b. False)
5. What food should we choose?
6. We may feel happy if we eat fat rich food. (a. True  b. False)
7. Give the passage a suitable title.

B/ Answer or complete (5) of the following sentences using information from your text book: (10 M.)
1. People have to follow the law so that we can ................
2. The pressure of life will (a. cause health problems  b. kill us  c. make us lose our jobs).
3. There are two main problems with radar detectors. (a. True  b. False)
4. Zaid Tariq was (a. a bad swimmer  b. on holiday).
5. Some radar guns are shaped a bit like guns. (a. True  b. False)
6. Mustafa found his mother in the kitchen. (a. True  b. False)
7. Samira Al Mahmoud was born in (a. Iraq  b. Britain).

Q2) Grammar and Functions: (30 Marks)

2. If I had lots of money. I (buy) a racehorse. (Correct the form of the verb)
3. Last year, my friend Zeina (get) hurt in a car accident. (Correct the form of the verb)
4. I've studied hard for the test. so I think I'll pass. (Expectation, use: "should")
5. If I (not pass) the high school exam this year, I'll take it again next year. (Correct the form of the verb)
6. Define an architect. (Use: "designs buildings")
7. I (think) about you and then you rang me. (Put the verb in the past continuous)
8. I can't remember when I (took up) it. (Put in the correct order)
9. Let's take Jameel to the new Italian restaurant. He never went there. (Correct the sentence)
10. How short do you want your hair? The hairdresser asked me how short I .................. (Reported question)
11. I (have) a bicycle, but someone stole it last month. (Use the correct form of "used to")
12. Unfortunately, I ate three bars of chocolate. That's why I felt sick. (Regret, use: "I wish")

B/ Choose the correct word between brackets: (5 only)   (10 M.)
1. How (much / many) apples do we need?
2. Life is (fast / faster) now than it used to be.
3. I've met her a (few / little) times.
4. This book is very (bored / boring).
5. When you get in a car, you (must / mustn't) put on your seat belt.
6. My father made me (go / went) back to my room.
7. We have been married (for / since) 2003.

Q3) Vocabulary and Spelling: (20 Marks)

text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
دور 1 احيائي / 2021 / Aug.

Q1) Reading comprehensions: (20 Marks)
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the following questions. (10 M.)

Harry marsh was a driving examiner who had to test people who wanted to get a driving-licence. One day he came out of his office as usual and saw a car at the side of the road, with a young man in it. He got into the car beside the driver and told him to check the lights, then the brakes and then the all the other usual things. The driver performed everything promptly and faultlessly. Without saying a word. Then Harry told the driver to start his engine and drive forward. Then he told him to turn right into a side road, stop, go backwards into another side road and then drive to the office again. On the way, the driver said to harry politely, "could you please tell me why we are doing all these things? I was passing through this town and only stopped to look at my map."

Millions of people are attacked by a secret enemy which causes more harm and greater suffering than any other disease. Its name is worry. According to doctors, worry can actually cause organic disease, and even when it does not, it can eat up our energy in many ways, ruin our health and make life miserable. Worry is a very dangerous enemy. The stress of life may make us worry about silly things. Worry affects nearly everybody in society from teenagers to elderly people. Students worry about their exams. Parents worry about their children. Young men and women worry about their future life. Needless to say, worry is the result of thinking in a wrong way. It is a fact that thinking over worries brings about more worries. We must face life as it is bravely. The problems a worrier faces are the same that the others face. To overcome worry, cultivate different interests, develop contact with a large number of people and spend your leisure in a useful hobby. When feeling worried, retire to a quiet corner and relax.

subject: إنكليزي
text:
English for Iraq — 6th Grade Preparatory
دور اول / ادبي / تطبيقي / 2022 / July

Q1) Reading Comprehension: (20 Marks)
A/ Read this text carefully then answer (5) of the questions that follow.   (10 M.)

Six people were travelling in a compartment on a train. Five of them were quiet and well behaved, but the sixth was a rude young man who was causing a lot of trouble to the other passengers. At last, this young man got out at a station with his two heavy bags. None of the other passengers helped him, but one of them waited until the rude young man was very far away, and then opened the window and shouted to him, "you left something behind in the compartment!" Then he closed the window again. The young man turned around and hurried back with his two bags. He was very tired when he arrived, but he shouted through the window, "What did I leave behind?" As the train began to move again, the passenger who had called him back opened the window and said, "A very bad impression!"

كان ستة أشخاص يسافرون في مقصورة في قطار. كان خمسة منهم هادئين وحسني السلوك، لكن السادس كان شاباً وقحاً ويسبب الكثير من المتاعب للركاب الآخرين. أخيراً، نزل هذا الشاب في إحدى المحطات بحقيبتيه الثقيلتين. لم يساعده أي من الركاب الآخرين، لكن أحدهم انتظر حتى ابتعد الشاب الوعching عن الأنظار، ثم فتح النافذة وصاح به، "لقد نسيت شيئاً في المقصورة!" ثم أغلق النافذة مرة أخرى. استدار الشاب وعاد مسرعاً بحقيبتيه. كان متعباً جداً عندما وصل، لكنه صاح من خلال النافذة، "ماذا نسيت ورائي؟" عندما بدأ القطار يتحرك مرة أخرى، فتح الراكب الذي ناداه ونافس "انطباع سيئ جداً!"

1. How was the sixth passenger in the compartment different from the other five?
2. What did the sixth passenger take with him when he got out?
3. What did a passenger shout to the young man when he was very far away?
4. What did the sixth passenger ask when he got back to the compartment window?
5. What impression did the young man leave behind?
6. Give the passage a suitable title.

B/ Answer or complete (5) of the following sentences using information from your text book:   (10 M.)

10. I spoke to a lady on the phone. She told me to call back later. The lady ………. (Use the correct relative pronoun to make one sentence)
11. …………….. Tea is better for your heart and can even lower your blood pressure. (Use an imperative to give advice)
